terminal.def: A main building at an airport or transport hub.
terminal.ex: Our flight departs from terminal two.

platform.def: The raised structure beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.
platform.ex: The express train departs from platform four.

single ticket.def: A ticket valid for a journey in one direction only.
single ticket.ex: A single ticket to the city center costs three pounds.

return ticket.def: A ticket valid for travel to a destination and back.
return ticket.ex: Buying a return ticket is cheaper than two single tickets.

boarding pass.def: A card or digital pass giving a passenger permission to board an aircraft.
boarding pass.ex: Please show your passport and boarding pass at the gate.

luggage.def: Bags, trunks, and suitcases containing personal belongings for travel.
luggage.ex: The porter helped us load our heavy luggage.

delay.def: A period of time during which an event or service is delayed.
delay.ex: Bad weather caused a one-hour flight delay.

flight.def: A journey made by flying in an aircraft.
flight.ex: Our flight to Barcelona was smooth and pleasant.

whiteboard.def: A large smooth white board for writing on with dry-erase markers.
whiteboard.ex: The teacher wrote today's vocabulary on the whiteboard.

pe.def: Physical education classes taught in schools.
pe.ex: We played volleyball during PE class this morning.

programmer.def: A person who writes code to create software and computer programs.
programmer.ex: An experienced programmer built our company website.

designer.def: A person who plans the look or structure of objects, clothing, or graphics.
designer.ex: The graphic designer created a stylish new logo.

lawyer.def: A qualified professional who advises clients on legal matters.
lawyer.ex: Our lawyer reviewed the lease contract carefully.

salary.def: A fixed regular payment made by an employer to an employee.
salary.ex: Employees receive their monthly salary on the last Friday.

tablet.ex: She reads digital textbooks on her tablet.

headphones.def: A pair of small speakers worn over or inside the ears.
headphones.ex: He listened to music through his wireless headphones.

app.def: A software program designed for mobile devices or computers.
app.ex: Download the transit app to view live bus schedules.

password.def: A secret string of characters used to log into an account.
password.ex: Never share your secret account password with anyone.

video call.def: A telephone call transmiting real-time video and audio.
video call.ex: We scheduled a video call with our overseas colleagues.

nature.def: The physical world including plants, animals, landscapes, and natural forces.
nature.ex: Taking walks in nature helps reduce daily stress.

mountain.def: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly.
mountain.ex: Snow covered the top of the high mountain peak.

hill.def: A naturally raised area of land, smaller than a mountain.
hill.ex: They walked up the green hill to enjoy the view.

valley.def: A low area of land between hills or mountains.
valley.ex: A sparkling river winds through the fertile valley.

forest.def: A large area of land covered densely with trees and undergrowth.
forest.ex: Birds sing in the quiet pine forest.

jungle.def: An area of land overgrown with dense tropical vegetation.
jungle.ex: Monkeys and parrots live in the tropical jungle.

river.def: A large natural stream of water flowing towards the sea or a lake.
river.ex: Boats sail along the wide river.

lake.def: A large body of water surrounded entirely by land.
lake.ex: We rented a small wooden boat on the lake.

sea.def: The expanse of salt water that covers most of the earth's surface.
sea.ex: Ships travel across the open sea.

ocean.def: A vast body of salt water covering major areas of the globe.
ocean.ex: Whales migrate across the deep ocean.

beach.def: A pebbly or sandy shore beside a body of water.
beach.ex: Children love building sandcastles on the sunny beach.

island.def: A piece of land surrounded by water on all sides.
island.ex: We took a ferry to visit the picturesque island.

desert.def: A dry barren region of land with very little rainfall.
desert.ex: Camels can travel long distances across the hot desert.

field.def: An area of open land, especially one used for pasture or crops.
field.ex: Yellow sunflowers bloom across the farmer's field.

tree.def: A tall perennial plant with a wooden trunk and spreading branches.
tree.ex: Apples grow on the large tree in our garden.

flower.def: The colorful blossom of a plant.
flower.ex: She placed a vase of fresh red flowers on the table.

grass.def: Low green vegetation growing on lawns and pastures.
grass.ex: Cows graze peacefully on the green grass.

cloud.def: A visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere.
cloud.ex: White fluffy clouds drifted across the blue sky.

fog.def: A thick mist of tiny water droplets hanging low near the ground.
fog.ex: Dense morning fog reduced visibility on the highway.

freezing.def: Extremely cold, near or below the freezing point of water.
freezing.ex: Dress warmly because it is freezing outside today.

tiger.def: A large wild Asian cat with distinctive black stripes on orange fur.
tiger.ex: The tiger stalked quietly through the forest shadow.

reading.def: The action or skill of reading books and written material.
reading.ex: Reading daily improves your language skills.

drawing.def: A picture or diagram produced with pencils or pens.
drawing.ex: She submitted a detailed charcoal drawing.

gardening.def: The activity of cultivating and caring for a garden.
gardening.ex: Gardening is her favorite weekend hobby.

fishing.def: The activity or sport of catching fish.
fishing.ex: He spent Sunday morning fishing by the riverbank.

camping.def: The activity of spending holidays outdoors in a tent.
camping.ex: We packed sleeping bags for our weekend camping trip.

travelling.def: The activity of visiting different places and foreign countries.
travelling.ex: Travelling opens your mind to diverse world cultures.

gaming.def: The activity of playing interactive video games.
gaming.ex: Online gaming with friends is popular among teens.

dancing.def: The movement of the body in a rhythmic way, usually to music.
dancing.ex: Dancing salsa is a fun way to stay active.

singing.def: The act or vocal performance of producing musical sounds with the voice.
singing.ex: She practices singing in the local choir every Tuesday.

soccer.def: A game played by two teams of eleven players kicking a spherical ball.
soccer.ex: Kids play soccer on the school field during recess.

volleyball.def: A game in which two teams hit a ball back and forth over a high net.
volleyball.ex: We played beach volleyball during our summer holiday.

swimming.def: The sport or activity of moving through water using limbs.
swimming.ex: Swimming is a great low-impact full-body exercise.

running.def: The activity or sport of running on foot as exercise.
running.ex: He goes running in the park every morning at six.

cycling.def: The sport or activity of riding a bicycle.
cycling.ex: Cycling to work is healthy and environmentally friendly.

skiing.def: The sport or activity of sliding over snow on skis.
skiing.ex: We go skiing in the Swiss Alps every winter.

yoga.def: A Hindu spiritual and physical discipline involving posture and breath control.
yoga.ex: Practicing morning yoga helps stretch muscles and relax.

pitch.def: An outdoor playing area marked for sports such as football.
pitch.ex: The referee stepped onto the football pitch.

court.def: A marked rectangular area for playing games such as tennis or basketball.
court.ex: They reserved the indoor tennis court for two hours.

match.def: A contest or game in which people or teams compete.
match.ex: Our local team won the championship match.

team.def: A group of players forming one side in a competitive game.
team.ex: All eleven players worked together as a cohesive team.

score a goal.def: To kick or strike a ball into the opponent's net to score a point.
score a goal.ex: The striker scored a goal in the final minute of play.

zero.ex: The temperature dropped to zero degrees overnight.

two.ex: Two passenger trains arrived at the station simultaneously.

three.ex: We waited three hours for our flight.

twenty.ex: There are twenty students in our English class.

forty.ex: A standard work week consists of forty hours.

fifty.ex: Fifty percent of the participants answered correctly.

hundred.ex: One hundred years make one century.

thousand.ex: More than a thousand people attended the festival.

million.ex: The city has a population of two million residents.

third.def: Coming immediately after second in order or rank.
third.ex: She finished in third position in the race.

light blue.def: Having a pale or light shade of blue.
light blue.ex: She wore a light blue cotton shirt.

dark green.def: Having a deep or dark shade of green.
dark green.ex: Pine needles are dark green in color.

bright red.def: Having a vivid, vibrant red color.
bright red.ex: A bright red sports car drove past the office.

circle.def: A perfectly round two-dimensional geometric shape.
circle.ex: Draw a circle on the paper with a compass.

triangle.def: A two-dimensional geometric shape with three straight sides and three angles.
triangle.ex: A slice of pizza resembles a triangle.

rectangle.def: A four-sided geometric shape with four right angles.
rectangle.ex: The computer monitor screen is a rectangle.

star.def: A conventional geometric symbol with five or six pointed arms.
star.ex: The teacher placed a gold star on her test.

diamond.def: A quadrilateral geometric shape with four equal sides placed obliquely.
diamond.ex: Road signs in the area are shaped like a diamond.

cube.def: A solid three-dimensional object with six equal square faces.
cube.ex: Drop an ice cube into the glass of lemonade.

sphere.def: A perfectly round three-dimensional solid ball shape.
sphere.ex: The Earth is an oblique spherical planet.

cylinder.def: A solid or hollow geometric object with straight parallel sides and circular ends.
cylinder.ex: Soup comes stored in a metal cylinder can.

cone.def: A solid or hollow object tapering smoothly from a circular base to a point.
cone.ex: He enjoyed a chocolate ice cream cone.

curved.def: Having a bending or non-straight line or surface.
curved.ex: The scenic mountain road follows a curved path.
